THE EXAMPLE CORPORATION DEFERRED COMPENSATION PLAN Amended and Restated Effective January 1, 2025

1.1 Purpose. The Plan lets a select group of management defer pay. The Plan is unfunded for tax purposes, and for Title I of ERISA.

1.2 Effective Date. The effective date of the amended and restated Plan is January 1, 2025.

2.1 Plan Administrator. Plan Administrator means the Senior Vice President, Global Total Rewards.

3.1 Deferral Elections. A Participant may defer up to 50% of base salary and 100% of the annual bonus each Plan Year, by an election made before the Plan Year begins.

4.1 Payment. Accounts are paid in a lump sum or in up to ten annual installments after separation from service.
